notes: Citations distinguish background literature from implemented reduced-order calculations. Bundled PDFs were uploaded by the user; nonbundled third-party PDFs are linked to their original publishers. No material values are grade-qualified.

references.title: Nose cone design
references.relevance: Profile equations for conic, ogive, elliptical, parabolic, power-series, Haack, and related shapes.
references.implementation: Geometry families implemented with stated approximations; not a computational aerodynamic validation.

references.title: mmWave Radar Radome Design Guide
references.authors: C. Kumar, H. U. R. Mohammed, and G. Peake
references.relevance: Single-wall RF dielectric behavior, thickness resonance, angle sensitivity, and test considerations.
references.implementation: Background support for locally planar dielectric-wall RF model; guide is not implemented verbatim.

references.title: A Novel Instrument for Real-Time Measurement of Attenuation of Weather Radar Radome Including Its Outer Surface. Part I: The Concept
references.authors: A. Mancini, J. L. Salazar, R. M. Lebrón, and B. L. Cheong
references.publication: Journal of Atmospheric and Oceanic Technology, 35(5)
references.relevance: Wet/dirty radome measurement methods and external film/reflection effects.
references.implementation: Literature for future environmental RF model; not implemented.

references.title: Flight Capabilities of High-Speed-Missile Radome Materials
references.relevance: Historical high-temperature material tradeoffs, erosion, thermal/mechanical constraints and radar aberration.
references.implementation: Qualitative design context only; no flight qualification, aeroheating, or boresight model implemented.

references.title: Electromagnetic Performance Analysis of Inhomogeneous Radome Walls Considering Temperature and Ablation
references.relevance: Transfer/cascade matrix transmission for wall layers, thermal changes, and ablation of graded materials.
references.implementation: Related mathematical foundation for local slab transmission; monolithic-only model, no ablation or graded wall.

references.title: A Drop Size Distribution (DSD)-Based Model for Evaluating the Performance of Wet Radomes for Dual-Polarized Radars
references.publication: Journal of Atmospheric and Oceanic Technology, 31, 2409–2430
references.relevance: Rain droplet distributions, hydrophobicity, dielectric wet-layer modeling and cross-polarized losses.
references.implementation: Literature for future wet-radome model; precipitation effects not implemented.

references.title: High temperature ceramic radomes (HTCR) – A review
references.authors: A. Nag, R. Ramachandra Rao, and P. K. Panda
references.relevance: Survey of high-temperature RF-ceramic candidates and manufacturing/property tradeoffs.
